import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n_count;
    static List<long[]> matA = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[][][] T_array;
    static List<Map<Long, Long>> DP_map = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] family_size = new int[1 << 7];
    static int[] family_idx = new int[1 << 7];
    static List<List<Integer>> family_mask_list2 = new ArrayList<>();

    static long sum_ll(long a, long b) {
        return (a + b) % MOD;
    }

    static long diff_ll(long a, long b) {
        a -= b;
        return (a < 0) ? a + MOD : a;
    }

    static long mul_ll(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    static long pow_ll(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        long cur = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = mul_ll(result, cur);
            }
            cur = mul_ll(cur, cur);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long inv_ll(long x) {
        return pow_ll(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static void compute() {
        int maxFamilySize = n_count;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n_count); ++mask) {
            family_size[mask] = family_size[mask >> 1] + (mask & 1);
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n_count); ++mask) {
            int size = family_size[mask];
            if (family_mask_list2.size() <= size) {
                while (family_mask_list2.size() <= size) {
                    family_mask_list2.add(new ArrayList<>());
                }
            }
            family_idx[mask] = family_mask_list2.get(size).size();
            family_mask_list2.get(size).add(mask);
        }
        T_array = new long[n_count + 1][maxFamilySize + 1][1 << n_count];
        for (int k = 0; k <= n_count; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < family_mask_list2.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                int cm = family_mask_list2.get(k).get(i);
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n_count); ++mask) {
                    long ans = 0;
                    if ((mask & cm) == mask) continue;
                    for (int x = 0; x < n_count; ++x) {
                        if ((cm & (1 << x)) != 0) continue;
                        if ((mask & (1 << x)) == 0) continue;
                        int newmask = cm | (1 << x);
                        ans |= (1L << family_idx[newmask]);
                    }
                    T_array[k][i][mask] = ans;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n_count = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n_count; ++i) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            long[] row = new long[n_count];
            for (int j = 0; j < n_count; ++j) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(parts[j]);
                row[j] = mul_ll(val, inv_ll(100));
            }
            matA.add(row);
        }
        compute();

        for (int i = 0; i <= n_count; ++i) {
            DP_map.add(new HashMap<>());
        }
        DP_map.get(0).put(1L, 1L);
        for (int k = 0; k < n_count; ++k) {
            Map<Long, Long> currentDP = DP_map.get(k);
            Map<Long, Long> nextDP = DP_map.get(k + 1);
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentDP.entrySet()) {
                long mask = entry.getKey();
                long val = entry.getValue();
                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n_count; ++i) {
                    if (((mask & (1L << i)) != 0))
                        prob = mul_ll(prob, matA.get(k)[i]);
                    else
                        prob = mul_ll(prob, diff_ll(1, matA.get(k)[i]));
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < family_mask_list2.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                    if ((mask & (1L << i)) != 0) continue;
                    long newmask = 0;
                    long p = mul_ll(prob, val);
                    for (int j = 0; j < family_mask_list2.get(k).size(); ++j) {
                        if ((mask & (1L << j)) != 0)
                            newmask |= T_array[k][j][(int) (mask)];
                    }
                    if (newmask != 0) {
                        nextDP.put(newmask, sum_ll(nextDP.getOrDefault(newmask, 0L), p));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(DP_map.get(n_count).getOrDefault(1L, 0L));
    }
}
